privacy.notice: We store your name, your contact address, and when you can help.
privacy.title: Your information
privacy.what: We store your name, your contact address, which activities you can run, when you can help, and which slots you have taken. If you joined by invitation, that invitation and the address it was sent to are kept for a while afterwards and then deleted automatically.
privacy.why: We use it only to build the schedule. There is no tracking, no analytics and no third parties.
privacy.who: Planners and administrators at 4water can see your details. Other volunteers can see your name on the plan.
privacy.calendar: If you create a calendar link, the link itself is what grants access — a calendar app cannot log in. Anyone you give it to, or who finds it, can see when you are helping. It is yours to replace or switch off at any time on your own page, and doing so stops the old link working immediately.
privacy.attendance: After a shift, a planner records whether you turned up. It counts how much you have actually helped this season, and it is never used to decide what you are offered or allowed to take. If it is marked wrongly, a planner can change it back — just ask.
privacy.changes: Changes to the plan and to people's details are logged: what changed, when, and who did it. That log is kept longer than messages are, so a question that arrives late can still be answered. If your details are erased, your name comes out of it and the entries stay as "somebody".
privacy.rights: You can always see and correct your own details. If you want them deleted, contact an administrator.

calendar.what: Subscribe once and your shifts show up in the calendar app on your phone, updating on their own when something changes. Add it as a subscribed calendar by URL — not as a one-off import, or it will never update.

If your details are erased, your notes go with them; a note somebody else wrote that mentions you cannot be found automatically, so ask an administrator.
